解説: 動詞にも形容詞にも使う
例文: I clean my room every Sunday.
Wash the dishes, please.
This dish is delicious.
She is wearing a red coat.

解説: 名詞にも動詞にも使う
例文: She bought a new dress.
Put on your coat.
The key is in my pocket.
Push the red button.
Please close the curtains.
Put the book on the shelf.
The pens are in the drawer.
Look at yourself in the mirror.
It is cold. Use this blanket.
The milk is in the refrigerator.
Do not touch the stove.
The dishes are in the sink.
The car is in the garage.
A bird is on the roof.
Be careful on the stairs.
Take the elevator to the fifth floor.
